Columba collects location data to enable Group Tracker and active Location Sharing sessions even when the app is closed or not in use.

Group Tracker automatically sends your location to the group host you choose at the interval you set so your group can see it. Active Location Sharing sessions keep sending to the contacts you chose for the duration you set. You can stop either at any time.

On the next screen, choose "Allow all the time" to enable this. If you don't want background sharing, choose "While using the app" or "Don't allow".
